changelog: v1.1.4 - Attendance notification is now a bigger, unswipeable, live-ticking notification; update re-download bug fixed
features: Attendance notification is now backed by a real foreground service so it can't be swiped away while punched in, and uses a bigger custom layout with a live chronometer on the right
Update check no longer re-downloads an already-downloaded version if you close the sheet before installing
Attendance notification posts once at punch-in and ticks live on its own (Android's chronometer) - no repeat alerts, and it's silent
Notification fix: push notifications now reach your phone for leave approvals, holidays, payslips, document status, and broadcasts
Attendance fix: punch-in/out time and "hours worked today" now show correctly
